outcome: Rate of delivery of the nonpresenting twin first
cohort: 942 women with dichorionic, opposite-sex twin pregnancies
finding: Delivery of the nonpresenting twin first occurred in 6.8% of cesarean deliveries in dichorionic, opposite-sex twin pregnancies.
gest_age: Less than 32 weeks gestation was associated with delivery of the non-presenting twin first.
birth_weight: Birth weight discordance greater than 25% was associated with delivery of the non-presenting twin first.
